subject.title: [Bug]: coding-agent completion notification fails with SecretRef-backed Gateway auth

question: Should coding-agent completion delivery move to the authenticated parent runtime, or should workers receive a new narrowly scoped notification capability?
rationale: The current worker-originated contract is broken for secure SecretRef configurations, but injecting the main Gateway credential changes the sandbox trust boundary and the permanent notification owner must be chosen explicitly.

options.title: Parent-owned relay
options.body: Have the parent monitor worker completion and deliver the captured result through its authenticated Gateway runtime without exposing credentials to the worker.

options.title: Scoped notification capability
options.body: Mint a single-purpose or tightly limited credential that authorizes only the captured completion route and message operation.

options.title: Preflight and decline
options.body: Detect unsupported secure automatic notification before useful worker work begins and require monitored completion without adding a credential bridge.

recommendation.title: Parent-owned relay
recommendation.body: Have the parent monitor worker completion and deliver the captured result through its authenticated Gateway runtime without exposing credentials to the worker.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both sustained coding-agent guidance and the central Gateway credential/call boundary needed for the decision.
